h1: Chaisaeng Villa Hotel — a top-rated boutique city hotel in Sing Buri
intro: If you are looking for a place in central Sing Buri with clean, spacious rooms, friendly service and consistently high guest scores at a gentle price — Chaisaeng Villa Hotel is a name travellers passing through Sing Buri know well · It is a 69-room boutique hotel in the Ton Pho area, near the Chao Phraya River and the provincial hall, with a modern lobby, a restaurant, a bar and an open-air beer garden · What guests agree on is that the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, the staff friendly and the value strong; the trade-offs are a simple breakfast and a location that is not within walking distance of the main shops · Rooms from approx. ฿900/night.

body.html: Chaisaeng Villa Hotel, known locally as Chaisaeng Villa, is a boutique city hotel in the Ton Pho area of Bang Phutsa, Mueang Sing Buri · It is a 69-room property with a modern lobby, a restaurant, a bar and an open-air beer garden — one of the highest-rated hotels in the province by guest reviews · Business travellers, people passing through, and families who want a clean city hotel with good service tend to choose it for its room quality and value.

Rooms come in a few types, from Superior (double bed) and Twin (two single beds) up to the larger VIP room · Inside you get air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator, and a private balcony in some rooms · What guests consistently praise is that the rooms are clean, spacious, the beds comfortable and the price fair, especially for what you get at around 900 baht · The trade-offs that come up in reviews are a bathroom design in some rooms where water spills outside the shower area, and housekeeping that is not always consistent in small details such as bins or floors.
"Clean, spacious rooms and a very comfortable bed for the price · Friendly, helpful staff, central location, easy to drive anywhere, and plenty of free parking."

What sets Chaisaeng Villa apart from a typical city hotel is its modern lobby and open-air beer garden · Many reviews note that the hotel looks new and clean, with nice spots to sit and a pleasant atmosphere, while the restaurant and buffet breakfast earn praise for taste · Most staff are praised for being friendly and helpful · The limitations guests mention are that the breakfast is simple with a small selection — some wish for more fruit and dessert — and a few reviews mention staff at checkout who seemed less warm; but overall it remains a hotel that delivers strong room quality and service at this price.

The central Ton Pho location is worth understanding before booking · It is close to the Chao Phraya River and the Sing Buri provincial hall, about a 5-minute drive to the town centre and food spots · Wat Phra Non Chak Si Worawihan and the old prang temples are not far, which suits travellers driving in who want to use Sing Buri as a stopover or touring base · The thing to note is that the hotel is not next to a walkable shopping street, so you will need the car to go out to eat or shop · The overall score sits around 9.1 from real guest reviews, and it ranks among the top hotels in the province across several platforms.

Honestly, Chaisaeng Villa is a city boutique hotel that gets the fundamentals right — clean, spacious rooms and friendly service — not a riverside resort or a hotel with a pool · If you want a river view or a rice-field resort, Chaisaeng Palace Hotel on the Chao Phraya River or Rim Thung Mae La Resort with its paddy views in the same province may suit you better · But if you want a clean central city hotel with spacious rooms, free parking, good service and high guest scores at a gentle price, this place does its job well and genuinely offers value — especially for self-drivers using Sing Buri as a stopover.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a VIP room or a larger room if you want more space and a balcony, since many guests say it is worth the small price difference · Check the bathroom at check-in, as water can spill outside the shower area in some rooms · Make the most of the free parking and central location to drive out to Wat Phra Non Chak Si or find good food in town · Always compare the direct rate against Agoda and Booking, as prices shift by season · And because breakfast is simple, plan to head out for noodles or a local breakfast in town if you want a fuller meal.

honestSummary: Chaisaeng Villa Hotel is a strong-value pick in Sing Buri for travellers who want a clean, spacious boutique city hotel with friendly service, free parking and high guest scores, at a gentle price · Cleanliness, room quality, service and value are the genuine strengths, especially for self-drivers using Sing Buri as a stopover — but accept that the breakfast is simple, some bathrooms let water spill outside the shower, and the hotel is not within walking distance of the shops.
honestChecks: If you want a riverside view or a waterfront resort — this is a central city boutique hotel, not on the water → try Chaisaeng Palace Hotel on the Chao Phraya River, or Rim Thung Mae La Resort with paddy-field views instead.

If you are particular about bathroom design and consistent housekeeping — reviews mention water spilling outside the shower and uneven upkeep in some details → check the bathroom at check-in and flag anything at the front desk.
If you expect a full breakfast and want to walk to shops — breakfast here is simple and you need a car to go out to eat → plan to head out for noodles or food in town in Sing Buri.

faqTitle: FAQ — Chaisaeng Villa Hotel, Sing Buri

faq.q: Where is Chaisaeng Villa Hotel in Sing Buri, and what is nearby?
faq.a: It is located at 11 Moo 1, Ton Pho, Mueang Sing Buri, in the city-centre area · Wat Phra Chot Karam is right next door within walking distance · The Chao Phraya River and the provincial hall are about a 5-minute drive · Wat Phra Non Chak Si Worawihan is about 10 minutes by car · FN Outlet Sing Buri is nearby · You will need a car to reach the town's restaurants and market.

faq.q: How much does Chaisaeng Villa Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at approx. ฿900/night for a Superior room · There is also a Twin Room (two single beds) and a larger VIP room, some with a balcony · Rates rise on holidays and during festivals, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Chaisaeng Villa Hotel best for?
faq.a: It is ideal for travellers who want a clean, spacious central boutique hotel with good service and free parking at a gentle price · It suits self-drivers using Sing Buri as a stopover or touring base, business travellers in town, and families who value cleanliness and value over a river view or a pool.

faq.q: What facilities does Chaisaeng Villa Hotel have?
faq.a: It has a restaurant, bar, terrace, open-air beer garden, buffet breakfast, free Wi-Fi and free parking, plus airport transfers and a local shuttle service (surcharge) · Rooms have air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, and balconies in some rooms · Note that the breakfast is simple with a small selection.

faq.q: What are the rooms and cleanliness like at Chaisaeng Villa Hotel?
faq.a: Clean, spacious rooms with comfortable beds and good value are what guests consistently praise, and the hotel looks new and modern · The trade-offs reviewers mention are a bathroom design in some rooms where water spills outside the shower, and housekeeping that is not always consistent in small details such as bins or floors · We recommend checking the bathroom at check-in.

faq.q: What is Chaisaeng Villa Hotel's review score — can I trust it?
faq.a: Chaisaeng Villa Hotel is a 69-room boutique hotel with a score of around 9.1 from real guest reviews, and it ranks among the top hotels in the province across several platforms · Its strengths are cleanliness, room quality, friendly service and value · It suits travellers wanting a good-quality central city hotel at a gentle price in Sing Buri.
